video_title: N3on Plays Basketball With Norman Powell!

quotes.speaker: Norman Powell
quotes.summary_phrase: Norman Powell on his shooting mechanics and muscle memory
quotes.excerpt: the further you're back, the less you care because it's a deeper shot

text_blocks.speaker: N3on
text_blocks.text: I feel like you shoot better further from the line. Why is that?

text_blocks.speaker: Norman Powell
text_blocks.text: I think the further you're back, the less you care because it's a deeper shot, so now you're just letting the muscle memory take over. When you're closer, you have defenders and you have more to think about. When you're back, guys aren't really guarding you because it's kind of a free shot.

quotes.speaker: Norman Powell
quotes.summary_phrase: Norman Powell on the toughest defenders to face
quotes.excerpt: I hate going up against Lou Dort. He be slapping, he be fouling.

text_blocks.speaker: N3on
text_blocks.text: Who is someone you have to go up against that gives you the most trouble on defense?

text_blocks.speaker: Norman Powell
text_blocks.text: I hate going up against Lou Dort. He be slapping, he be fouling. I mean, he moves his feet, he's a great defender, but he gets away with a lot of stuff. He's fast, he's physical, and he picks up way above the three-point line, so he makes things difficult.

quotes.speaker: Norman Powell
quotes.summary_phrase: Norman Powell identifies Nikola Jokic as the best player in the NBA
quotes.excerpt: Nikola Jokic. For sure, hands down.
quotes.quote: Nikola Jokic. For sure, hands down. He's the best player in the NBA right now that can change a whole team just by putting that guy on a team.

quotes.speaker: Norman Powell
quotes.summary_phrase: Norman Powell on Dwight Howard's dunking ability
quotes.excerpt: Dwight Howard was the hardest dunker of all time.
quotes.quote: Dwight Howard was the hardest dunker of all time. Shaq was breaking rims, but Dwight Howard was the hardest dunker.

quotes.speaker: Norman Powell
quotes.summary_phrase: Norman Powell on whether money buys happiness
quotes.excerpt: The most important things money can't buy, like family time, spending time with your loved ones.
quotes.quote: The most important things money can't buy, like family time, spending time with your loved ones, being able to hang out, priceless moments. Money brings comfort because you don't have to worry about bills or stress about things that I had to stress about growing up, but money is probably the root of all evil, honestly.

quotes.speaker: Norman Powell
quotes.summary_phrase: Norman Powell on the milestone of making the three-point contest
quotes.excerpt: Coming into the league, I was not a three-point shooter. I shot 29% in college.
quotes.quote: Coming into the league, I was not a three-point shooter. I shot 29% in college. So to actually be able to make it into the three-point contest with the top shooters in the league is actually a big milestone. One time, going through my pre-draft, a coach on a team said that I'll never be able to shoot NBA threes and my shot is broke. So to be in a three-point contest is actually kind of crazy.
